{{Aries}}

Aries is the 5th month of the [[Gaian calendar]]. It contains 28 days (4 weeks) and corresponds to ISO weeks 17–20.

== Overview ==
===Etymology===
English ''Aries'' "ram" (Latin). Japanese: {{ill|牡羊座|ja|Ohitsuji-za}} “ram-constellation.”  
===Gaiad themes===
Weeks 17–20 (Days [[Aries 1]]–[[Aries 28]]): expansion of land biotas and cultural arcs; consolidation chapters bridging spring observances.  
  
Aries is the charging bull coming in and representing the aggressive arrival of mammals  
===EVENTS===
* [[Aries 14]] — Cinco de Mayo
